digest.component_or_area: T11 plan review rubric (POST-ROLLBACK SCHEMA STATE)
propositions: The T11 plan review rubric generates tautological false-positive findings for append-only stores (8 of 21 sampled findings were near-identical post-rollback state advisories with median priority ~0.1).

Post-rollback findings should only be raised when a plan (a) changes interpretation of existing persisted records, (b) rewrites or migrates records in place, (c) removes or narrows a read path, or (d) performs a one-way transformation with no back-out.

Purely additive, backward-compatible persistence changes (new record types, optional fields, new tables/columns with defaults) should be explicitly excluded from post-rollback findings as they do not represent a risk in append-only or backward-compatible systems.
The applicability rule must be portable across store technologies (SQL, event stores, document databases, config formats) without naming specific technology.
